storageClass: premium private release objects (2026 is not a 0610 free year; free year is 2021). No Supabase objects.
method: buildReleaseManifest() from scripts/igcse-release.mjs over the May/June 2026 candidate runtime, minus the 13,953 objects already verified by data/storage/igcse-biology-0610.receipt.json. No client was created and no credentials were read.
operatorNotes: Owner approval is required before any upload.

npm run r2:sync does not handle igcse-biology-0610 (its SOURCES list has no 0610 entry); 0610 release objects go through scripts/igcse-release.mjs, which resolves sources from PASTPAPERPREP_IGCSE_BIOLOGY_SOURCE_ROOT.

The May/June 2026 crops live only under data/segmentation/full-extension-2026-mj/ of the source worktree on feat/2026-may-june-acquisition; the main source checkout does not have them until that branch lands. Point PASTPAPERPREP_IGCSE_BIOLOGY_SOURCE_ROOT at a checkout that has all four lanes (data/segmentation/full-ms-repair, data/segmentation/full-extension, data/segmentation/full-extension-2026-mj and the batch94 mark-scheme repair); the source worktree has them.

Upload: R2_ACCOUNT_ID/R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID/R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY plus PASTPAPERPREP_IGCSE_BIOLOGY_SOURCE_ROOT, then node scripts/igcse-release.mjs --upload igcse-biology-0610. It rewrites data/storage/igcse-biology-0610.manifest.json (14,733 objects), skips the 13,953 keys already in the receipt, uploads these 780 create-only (IfNoneMatch), then GET-verifies all 14,733 and rewrites the receipt.

Then node scripts/generate-igcse-release.mjs --finalize igcse-biology-0610, rerun the gates, and commit the manifest, receipt and finalized runtime together. Merge only after that: until finalized, the release gate keeps the whole 0610 bank closed (it requires verified_readback).
